summary: Professional Diversity Network filed an 8-K after effecting a one-for-thirty reverse stock split via a Delaware certificate of amendment, effective 5:30 p.m. ET September 11, 2026. Authority came from a July 13, 2026 special stockholder meeting and board action on August 26, 2026. Authorized shares and $0.0001 par value are unchanged; fractional shares are rounded up. Equity awards, options, warrants and convertibles are proportionately adjusted, including August 13, 2026 common warrants under their Share Combination Event provision. New CUSIP 74312Y509. Routine capital-structure action, not a special situation; watch Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance and warrant overhang.
